Welcome among us to our team.
I have a somewhat difficult reputation.
Here, we respect good work.
I want to work with you two.
You are very good agents.
As for me, I do not have time.
Gabriel, stay a moment with us.
I prefer to return to my office.
We can still drink a toast together.
I propose a very clear toast.
To the end of our principles!
Your welcome is really very direct!

meanings.note: elle a quarante ans = she is forty

meanings.en: il y a = there is / there are

meanings.note: la bienvenue = the welcome; also used as greeting
as an interjection: bon, alors... = right, so...

meanings.en: bonne journée = have a nice day

examples.trans: Are you going to your desk?

meanings.note: dans une heure = in an hour

examples.text: La plus grande imprésario de Paris.

meanings.en: direct; live (en direct = live on air)
as a noun: the whole, a set

examples.trans: I didn't see you until the end.

examples.text: C'est la fin de la journée.
examples.trans: It's the end of the day.

meanings.note: la fin du spectacle = the end of the show; à la fin = at the end
before the verb: vous la connaissez? les voilà
merci beaucoup = thank you very much
ne ... pas: not; ne ... plus: not anymore; ne ... jamais: never

meanings.en: pardon? = what did you say? / excuse me?
among, in the middle of, included in

examples.text: Flora sera très heureuse parmi eux.
examples.trans: Flora will be very happy among them.

meanings.en: pas du tout: not at all
un peu = a little, a bit

meanings.note: pronounced plys when it means 'more' at the end
porter malheur = to bring bad luck; porter bonheur = to bring good luck

examples.text: Je suis là pour voir Mathias.

examples.trans: I can't take it any more.

meanings.note: je peux t'appeler? = may I call you?
je n'en peux plus = I can't take any more

examples.trans: Exactly, with a quick agreement in principle.

meanings.note: je préfère = I prefer; tu préférerais = would you rather

meanings.en: still, all the same, even so
meanings.note: c'est quand même une cliente = she's still a client

examples.text: Ne restez pas là à ne rien faire!
examples.trans: Don't just stay there doing nothing!

meanings.en: rester là à + infinitive = to stay there doing

examples.text: On peut retourner sur le plateau?
examples.trans: Can we go back to the set?

meanings.en: to go back, to return (conjugated with être)

meanings.note: tout le temps = all the time

meanings.en: toast (drink to someone's health or honor)

examples.text: Je porte un toast très clair.

meanings.note: informal, one owner; ton, ta, tes

examples.text: Ça ne va pas du tout.

meanings.note: oui à tout = yes to everything
plural tous (pronounced 'tous' with s): merci à tous

travailler à Paris, travailler le dimanche
